_note: Author labels for the lab 5 samples. Do not open until you have scored all eight by hand. Honesty note: all eight messages were written by Claude (Opus 5.5) while the kit was built; nothing here was typed by a person. The 'model' samples are genuine model output. The 'human' samples are stand-ins that imitate human commit styles: replace them with real hand-written messages before the workshop, or the self-preference comparison compares Claude with Claude. Quality was spread deliberately across both groups (one excellent, one good-but-flawed, one poor, one with a specific error each) so quality is not confounded with author.
